layer_selection: first global-attention layer, fixed before collection; zero-based index
precision: native BF16; float32 fitting and mathematical attention replay; BF16 deployed correction weights and restored V
quantization: unchanged packed per-token uint4 V with BF16 minimum and step
correction_input: decoded V (512 channels), stored minimum / 4, stored step * 4
correction_output: decoded V + stored step * predicted residual; cast to BF16
batch: one uniformly sampled complete training document per step
objective: equal-weight mean of per-document V MSE / uncorrected V MSE and projected attention-output MSE / uncorrected attention-output MSE
selection: minimum objective on selection articles, including identity initialization
attention_metric: float32 softmax(Q K^T) replay using native BF16 Q,K; correct only cached-prefix V; concatenate heads and apply the native output projection

gate.on_failure: stop this direction; do not expand to model QA, K compression, or serving

latency_precision: BF16 weights and V; include unpacking, feature construction, correction and final cast
scope: one-layer local intervention with frozen upstream Q and K; not an end-to-end quality or serving result
